email_en.subject: Free-time page for ICEP 2027 attendees (May 12–15, Sapporo)
email_en.body:
Dear Organizer,

I hope you're well. I've put together a short free-time page for ICEP 2027 attendees staying at the Grand Mercure Sapporo Odori Park. It offers a few ideas for each day: early-morning seafood bowls at Nijo Market, a morning run in Odori Park, and evenings in Susukino with ramen, lamb and craft beer. There is also an optional extra night on May 15 in Yoichi and Otaru.

Could you take a look and, if it suits, share it with attendees through your usual channels? I'm happy to adjust anything.

Warm regards
